name: One-third–two-thirds conjecture
question: Does every finite non-total poset admit an incomparable pair balanced within [1/3,2/3] across linear extensions?
first_attack: Find a robust invariant for linear-extension balance
method_title: Replay the object, or mine the census
dispatch_next: The certified mine poset_balance finds 11 posets on at most 6 elements with best balance exactly 1/3, and every one of them has width 2, which Linial already settled. A new lemma has to treat width at least 3; this census has no tight example there.
dispatch_why: The poset_balance mine shows every tight example on at most 6 elements has width 2, which is Linial's settled case. Published verification already reaches 11 elements.

campaign.method: Exact linear-extension counting over certified poset censuses
campaign.hypothesis: Every finite poset that is not a chain has an incomparable pair x, y with 1/3 <= Pr[x < y] <= 2/3.
campaign.first_proof_obligation: State and prove a balance bound for a restricted poset class (bounded width or height) that improves on published results.
campaign.next_experiment: The certified mine poset_balance finds 11 posets on at most 6 elements with best balance exactly 1/3, and every one of them has width 2, which Linial already settled. A new lemma has to treat width at least 3; this census has no tight example there.
campaign.falsification: A non-chain poset whose every incomparable pair has balance below 1/3, with linear extensions counted exactly by two independent methods.
campaign.blocker: Published verification already reaches 11 elements; a new structural invariant is needed.

probes.name: One-third–two-thirds conjecture
probes.title: Balanced pairs (1/3-2/3 conjecture) for every poset up to N elements
probes.frontier: Known: verified for all posets with at most 11 elements (Peczarski) and for width-2 posets (Linial 1984); best general bound ~0.276 (Brightwell-Felsner-Trotter).

smoke.scope: Every non-chain poset with 2..6 elements has an incomparable pair x, y with 1/3 <= Pr[x < y] <= 2/3 over uniformly random linear extensions.

deep.scope: Every non-chain poset with 2..7 elements has an incomparable pair x, y with 1/3 <= Pr[x < y] <= 2/3 over uniformly random linear extensions.

milestones.title: 1/3-2/3 conjecture verified for every poset with at most 6 elements
milestones.description: All 1, 2, 5, 16, 63, 318 posets (orbit-counting certified against OEIS A001035); each non-chain poset has an exactly counted pair with balance >= 1/3, minimum exactly 1/3. Deep run: all 2,045 posets on 7 elements.

milestones.title: Posets of balance exactly 1/3 on at most 6 elements are width 2
milestones.scope: Inside the published verification through 11 elements, and inside Linial's width-2 theorem; not a new case
milestones.description: Eleven posets attain best balance 1/3. Their width-height types are 2x2, 2x3, 2x4 and 2x5. Balances are recounted by removing minimal elements.
